[[File:TranslationDroid.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Unidentified translation droid/Legends|A translation droid]]]]
{{Quote|Tell Uncle Owen if he gets a translator, make sure it speaks Bocce.|[[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun Lars]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Translator droids''', also known as '''interpreter droids''', were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] skilled in translating one [[Language/Legends|language]] into another. Their function was usually performed by [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. The [[RST Model Translator Droid]] and [[M-TD miniaturized translator droid]] were two types. Interpreter droids carried out errands within the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber]].

A translator droid was used aboard the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] to translate the [[Gand (language)/Legends|Gand]] that [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was using in order to convince the crew that the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Regina Galas'']] was just an ordinary vessel captained by a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]].
